## Draft ready — firm on the cap, generous on terms

Henrik's counsel pushed back on the 2x liability cap this morning. The draft below holds 1.5x using Amara's Option B language.

**To Henrik Dahl — Re: Nordvik MSA, round 2**

Thanks for the quick turn, Henrik. Glad we've closed out data residency. On the liability cap: 2x total fees isn't something we can underwrite at this contract size, but Option B gets you real protection — a 1.5x cap with SLA credits carved out entirely, so service failures never erode it. To keep your September rollout on track we'll also hold net-60 across the full 3-year term. Can your counsel review by Wednesday so we sign by Aug 21?

> Recommended: have Amara review the cap wording before it goes out.
